thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] us-east-1 /v1/generate p99 latency spike -> 7.8s, increase in 5xx (504) after deploy 2026-03-17T02:12Z. Initiating page.
alice: acked. oncall_sre, can you pick this up? :pager:
oncall_sre: on it. seeing spike across canary and a subset of prod nodes. p95 up from 120ms -> 1.3s, p99 ~7-8s. Errors: gateway timeouts and some 502s.
ben: rolling deploy went at 02:12, image tag release/opt-2026-03-17. Canary at 10% -> we pushed to 30% ~02:15.
marta: logs show long request queues on the API gateway, connections in CLOSE_WAIT rising. Could be connection drain/backoff between gateway and runtime.
oncall_sre: running quick PromQL: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}[2m])) by (le))` -> matches 7.6s.
oncall_sre: `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows some backend pods with `READY 0/1` then flapping.
alice: any recent config changes to keepalive or connection pooling? ben?
ben: no explicit keepalive change in this release. We did enable a small change to graceful shutdown backoff to avoid dropping in-flight KV cache sessions.
marta: that backoff tweak might delay connection drain and leave long-lived requests pinned to old workers. hypothesis: backoff increased, causing upstream queueing -> timeouts.
oncall_sre: good hypothesis. I'm going to scale down canary and roll it back for the group that started at 02:12. Triggering rollback now.
oncall_sre: rollback command: `deployctl rollback --service api --to-tag release/opt-2026-03-10 --namespace prod --selector canary=true`
oncall_sre: rollback started 02:22.
incident-bot: action: rollback started by oncall_sre. Notifying monitoring.
alice: I'm notifying SRE lead and product-ops for customer impact assessment. product-ops, please check any running customer sessions.
product-ops: looking at customer errors: a small fraction of customers hit 504s in us-east-1, ~1.8% of requests during spike window 02:12-02:24. No billing alerts yet. Sending advisory to CS to prepare for inbound.
oncall_sre: rollback completed 02:25. Observability: p99 dropped to 210ms within 90s after rollback. 5xx rate returning to baseline.
ben: confirm: rollout reverts canary pods to previous image; scaling removed the new backoff flag.
marta: capturing logs from affected pods and saving traces: `trace-id` samples show requests stuck waiting for backend connection while gateway retried.
alice: adding postmortem owner: @marta to own root cause, @ben to own deployment/backoff change, @oncall_sre to own mitigation & playbook updates.
oncall_sre: immediate mitigations noted: 1) rollback 2) disable canary rollout by default for this flag 3) update runbook to check graceful-shutdown/backoff after deploy.
product-ops: customer impact: minor, but we should send a status update if CS sees tickets. I'll draft a short status message.
ben: will open a PR to revert the backoff default and add integration test for connection drain behavior.
alice: handing off to followup shift: @marta you'll lead the RCA thread. oncall_sre please handoff remaining logs/traces at 02:36.
oncall_sre: Handoff complete. Leaving the channel to allow focused RCA followup. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: status -> mitigated (rollback). Please file postmortem and tag incident with rca:deploy-backoff-conn-drain."
